reviews.text: Sasha, my Siberian Husky, was groomed today by Lauren at the Galleria location. It was Lauren’s first time grooming her and it’s shedding season. When I got home my partner and I realized she did such a phenomenal job that I had to call back to get her name for this review. This is one of the best Sasha has ever looked. She went in as a big back and came out like Beyoncé LOL. Thank you Lauren!
Meadowlake takes the best care of my Charlie ! They are very attentive, loving  and always give him the best care. Highly recommend Meadowlake for doggy daycare !

This was my first time bringing my furbaby to Meadowlake for grooming services and I’m OVERLY Satisfied with their service! My baby look and smelled so good I almost cried he was so handsome lol ! It’s a few things I don’t play about and one of them is my FURBABY and I was more than comfortable at pickup ! From the front desk staff to the groomer was a 10/10 experience!
